title: Probability of matching one input
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $g$ and $x$ be Boolean functions on the $n$ coordinates. If a Boolean function on these coordinates is chosen uniformly at random, the probability that its value at $x$ equals $g(x)$ is $1/2$.
